decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plan Floor Plan 1:100, received on 30 January 2006, submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for medical and non-medical services and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Cranstoun and shall be for a limited until 13 April 2018, or the period during which the premises are occupied by Cranstoun whichever is the shorter.
Condition : 5 - The counselling, treatment and training facilities hereby approved shall be available to clients on an appointments only basis.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby approved shall not be open to clients outside the following times: 10.00am to 9.00pm Mondays to Fridays and 10.00am to 6.00pm Saturdays
Condition : 7 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the submitted site plan shall be kept permanently and shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 8 - Two wheelchair users' parking spaces shall be provided on site at all times while the use continues on the site.
description: Variation of condition 6 (The use hereby approved shall not be open to clients outside the following times: 10.00am to 6.00pm Mondays to Saturdays) of planning permission of planning permission 00896/A/P4 dated 13/04/2006 to extend the opening hours of service by 3 hours to 10am-9pm (Mon-Fri).
